LESSON: SCRIPTURAL TEXT AND ROLE OF SIKH SCRIPTURES SAHIB IN SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI 17

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do the Scriptures influence your lifestyle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation
2. appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SCRIPTURAL TEXT AND ROLE OF SIKH SCRIPTURES SAHIB IN SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI 17
This lesson teaches Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 for Grade 9 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 above.
2. Explain Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Scriptural Text and role of Sikh Scriptures sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji 17 important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do the Scriptures influence your lifestyle?
2. How does the recitation of the Scriptures help to acquire self-efficacy?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the compilation of Sri Sukhmani Sahib in Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji for internalisation
2. appreciate the teachings of the Sikh Scriptures for spiritual development

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
